feeling: Glass-hour running from something: the same tune, twice as fast and getting faster, over a line that will not stop.
intent: Glass-hour at speed for a short: the tune at its own height on the bright driven sound you kept, over a running line of fast low notes that speeds up until it breaks. Nobody has heard it: it was checked by measurement only.
